gloss: original plan; draft proposal; original concept

definitions.explanation: The initial version of a plan, bill, or proposal before revisions are made. Common in legislative and organizational contexts.
The original idea or story that a creative work (manga, anime, film) is based on, credited to the person who conceived it.

examples.japanese: {原案|げんあん}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was passed as per the original proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{原案|げんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修正|しゅうせい}した→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The committee revised the draft proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原案|げんあん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}した→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The original draft of the bill was significantly changed before it was enacted.

examples.japanese: {原案|げんあん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{小説家|しょうせつか}→小説家：03070_shousetsuka⟧だ。
examples.english: The original concept is by a famous novelist.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原案|げんあん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実話|じつわ}→実話：15897_jitsuwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいている→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧。
examples.english: The original concept for this film is based on a true story.

examples.japanese: {原案|げんあん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{脚本|きゃくほん}→脚本：04459_kyakuhon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The original concept and the screenplay are handled by different people.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原案|げんあん}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧ (as per the original plan)
- {原案|げんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修正|しゅうせい}する→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧ (revise the draft)
- {原案|げんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧ (draw up a draft proposal)
- {原案|げんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (pass the original proposal)

USAGE:
In legislative contexts, {原案|げんあん}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧ means the proposal was approved without changes. In creative works (manga, anime, film), {原案|げんあん} in the credits refers to the person who provided the original concept or story idea, distinct from ⟦{原作|げんさく}→原作：11827_gensaku⟧ which means the original complete work that was adapted.
